summary: Add durable explicitly confirmed single-worker execution jobs for frozen Reference evaluations without removing existing execution paths.
decision_refs: CRIP is the local file, task, result, citation and review management layer
A managed reference evaluation should not depend on keeping one browser tab open
Earlier confirmation cannot authorize automatic model dispatch after a service interruption
approval_evidence: The active user goal requires CRIP to manage reproducible advanced-model tasks and reduce unnecessary manual work while retaining local evidence and explicit model-call control.
known_limitations: Only one managed evaluation job may be active globally; this is intentional provider-call serialization.
Interrupted, stopped or halted work is resumed by creating another explicitly confirmed job rather than mutating the old job.
The browser lists the newest 20 jobs; older job rows remain available through the detail API and local database.
Offline acceptance does not run or score a stronger model.
